title: lithocarpus daphnoideus
intro: Lithocarpus daphnoideus, commonly known as Bur oak or Lithocarpus, is a species of plant in the family Fagaceae. It is a deciduous tree native to China and Taiwan, known for its large size and distinctive leaves. The health benefits of Lithocarpus daphnoideus include its potential use in treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
